reentry.reason: A parallel Trigger-2 organ had already committed and pinned the canonical physical GRID10 v2 harness. The duplicate proof lane was removed from current main to preserve one implementation/execution authority.

unique_donor_delta_preserved.problem: Declared NODE_RESULT epoch/digest equality is weaker than proof that the payload was actually produced from those consumed S1 bytes.
unique_donor_delta_preserved.candidate_mechanism: Bind a source-hash-qualified producer/read receipt to producer PID, source node id, consumed generation/epoch/digest, consumed selected-task digest and payload digest; require declared snapshot identity to equal consumed identity before deterministic coordinator admission.
unique_donor_delta_preserved.adversarial_case: Produce payload from an older S1 observation, then rewrite only declared state_epoch/state_digest/generation and recompute packet_digest. A consumed-snapshot gate must still reject.
unique_donor_delta_preserved.boundary: A self-authored receipt hash alone is not authoritative attestation. Credit requires exact source-bound producer execution or a stronger trusted read-to-result measurement.

hypothesis: Exact source-bound producer execution plus an explicit read-to-result receipt can distinguish genuine current observations from metadata-rewritten stale payloads more strongly than packet epoch/digest equality alone.
counterhypothesis: The current canonical v2 harness's exact source binding, explicit read transaction, writer-free barrier, per-process PID binding and stale epoch/digest rejection may already make an additional in-packet receipt redundant for bounded physical GRID10 component credit.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator: After the pinned canonical v2 repository-bound run returns, construct one deterministic declared-current/consumed-stale adversarial producer fixture against the exact executed source. If current acceptance can be fooled without changing trusted source identity, promote an explicit read-to-result attestation gate; otherwise retain the receipt design as a donor and avoid redundant protocol surface.
